items.body: For releases prior to January 19, 2022, refer to Announcements in the Selling Partner API GitHub repo . August 5, 2026 API changes Tracking API v2026-01-30 Launched the new Tracking API with one operation available in the US store. The getShipmentTracking operation allows sellers and vendors to retrieve tracking details for a shipment as it moves through Amazon’s supply chain. For more information, refer to Tracking API . Notifications V1 Launched the SHIPMENT_TRACKING_MILESTONE_CHANGED notification type. Sellers and vendors can subscribe to this notification type to receive real-time tracking updates for a shipment as it moves through Amazon's supply chain. For more information, refer to the Subscribe to shipment tracking notifications tutorial. Added support for the SHIPMENT_TRACKING_MILESTONE_CHANGED notification type to eventFilterType in the getSubscription operation. You can use the new corresponding TrackingFilter schema to specify a tracking identifier when subscribing to this notification type. Documentation changes Added the Retrieve multi-shipment package tracking details guide for Fulfillment Outbound API. This guide explains how to retrieve tracking information for all packages in a Multi-Channel Fulfillment order. Added the Retrieve delivery tracking information guide for Fulfillment Outbound API. This guide explains how to get delivery tracking information for a package in an outbound shipment for a Multi-Channel Fulfillment order. Added the Track a partially fulfilled order guide for Fulfillment Outbound API. This guide explains how to track a partially fulfilled order for items that are low inventory. In this episode, Bradley Sutton travels to Tallinn, Estonia to catch up with Ranno Tasane, the entrepreneur behind Jungle Powders and a partner in Spot Minders. Ranno shares how his journey started with print-on-demand before moving into Amazon FBA, where Jungle Powders eventually grew into a multimillion-dollar brand despite expensive sourcing and increasing competition. But the biggest story is Spot Minders. The Apple Find My-certified tracking brand began on Shopify before Ranno joined the team to lead the Amazon side of the business. One of the biggest factors behind its explosive growth has been speed and creative volume. The team produces around 150 unique creatives every week, then tests multiple hooks and angles for each one—resulting in roughly 600 to 700 ad uploads per week. That relentless testing helped the company go from its first $1 million month to its first $10+ million month roughly a year later. Ranno also breaks down how Shopify, Meta, and Amazon work together instead of competing against each other.
